messages:
jordan_sales: Pasting the first pass of the Palisade capability matrix and a few open asks. Need SE + security eyes before we send to the prospect. Uploaded the sheet and a short decision log below.

jordan_sales: Key asks: 1) Dedicated throughput numbers for 8xA100 equivalent, 2) Private on-prem HSM answer for KMS, 3) POC timeline & estimate for cost.

jordan_sales: file uploaded: palisade_capability_matrix_v0.3.xlsx (see bottom for which tabs need numbers)

ellie_se: Got it. I can fill in throughput + latency columns. Which model variant are they evaluating?

jordan_sales: They're testing redwood-2-small (~7B) for intent/classification and a 13B for generation in canary.

ellie_se: For Dedicated (8xA100) our empirical numbers for rw-2-small (seq 512, batch 16): p50=18ms token, p95=78ms token, throughput ~650 tokens/s. For 13B (seq 1024, batch 8): p50=45ms, p95=210ms, throughput ~320 tokens/s. I'll put these into the matrix.

ellie_se: Benchmark command used: ```./bench_runner --model redwood-2-small --seq 512 --batch 16 --workers 8 --warmup 200 --step 1000```

rajesh_security: Quick security notes to include in RFI answers: KMS integration: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/GCP KMS/Azure Key Vault. HSM: we offer HSM-backed key wrapping for Private (on-prem) installs, but for Hosted we provide envelope encryption with customer CMKs. Need to confirm FedRAMP timeline if they require it.

jordan_sales: @rajesh_security they specifically asked about FIPS 140-2 and HSM-backed signing for token encryption. Can you give one-liners for the matrix?

rajesh_security: One-liners: "Supports CMK via AWS/GCP/Azure; Private deployments can integrate with customer HSMs for key storage and signing. Hosted uses envelope encryption with customer CMKs; FIPS compliance available via Private or partner-hosted appliances."

rajesh_security: Also note: audit logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM (syslog/CloudWatch) and we retain admin-level logs for 365 days by default for Dedicated/Private customers.

sam_prod: For the POC timeline: recommend 4 weeks — week 0: kickoff & account setup, week 1: model onboarding + baseline tests, week 2: scale tests and latency tuning, week 3: validation + docs handoff. Estimate: 80 engineer-hours across SE + infra + security.

taylor_finance: Pricing ask: for a 4-week POC with Dedicated reserved 8xA100 equivalent and 2TB token storage for KV/cache, rough cost estimate is $48k for infra + $12k professional services. I'll add a pricing row.

jordan_sales: Can someone flag any blockers for the prospect's network topology? They need private peering to an existing VPC and Egress IP allowlisting.

ellie_se: Blocker: their VPC uses strict egress rules and a shared transit gateway; we need networking contact to open 443 to our peering endpoints and allow health-check cidrs. I'll add a networking checklist in the matrix tab named "POC-ops-checklist".

ops_bot: meeting scheduled: POC kickoff with Palisade on Tue 2024-06-11 10:00 PDT. Invite sent to jordan_sales, ellie_se, rajesh_security, taylor_finance, palisade-contacts. :calendar: 

jordan_sales: Great. Final asks before I send RFI: 1) ellie — populate perf cells + link to raw bench logs, 2) rajesh — paste two-line KMS/HSM text into security tab, 3) taylor — confirm pricing row and add cancellation terms. Aim to ship final RFI + matrix by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

ellie_se: Will do, I'll attach bench logs (zip) and update numbers by EOD.

rajesh_security: Updated security tab and uploaded short FAQ paragraph on data residency.

jordan_sales: Thanks all — I'll assemble and send.
